systems.cue: Cue: Qloo data, code scoring, grounding guard

definitions.hit_rate_top10: Share of rows where the known answer is in the system's top 10, by name.
definitions.made_up_rate: Share of suggested names Qloo has no exact match for. Not found in Qloo, which is not always invented.
definitions.under_the_radar_share: Supervisor rows: share of found artists at or under the popularity cap.
definitions.answers_above_cap: Supervisor rows whose known answer is above the popularity cap. Cue leaves such artists out by design, so these rows are not scored for hits, for any system.

caveats: Known placements are famous, so Claude alone may recall them from training rather than reason about taste.
Qloo's taste data can reflect a placement after it happened, which may help Cue on old placements.
Two systems only: Claude alone and Cue. Claude with web search was not run.
